text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I didn't make first place... but that really
got me
going.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Positioning, direction, and timing—mess
up just
one of them and you're looking
at a completely
different outcome.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...You just never know what'll happen in
a race.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: And that's what makes it so much fun.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Yup, but spare me the boring "safe"
strategies. I
wanna go all out.
